728-6761-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
728-6761-7084.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

222-527-728-3480.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4890-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4890-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dack's Duplicate and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4890-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7726.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Virtuous Variant.
When Virtuous Variant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Virtuous Variant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1558-2638-4231-4772-5621.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-4231-4772-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2438-4556-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2438-4556-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Blight Mound and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

140-4050-4484-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
140-4050-4484-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've lost X or more life this turn.
140-4050-4484-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
140-4050-4484-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1687-6797-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-2557-5420.description:
Activate Plundering Pirate by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve the Plundering Pirate trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

413-856-2558-6748.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
413-856-2558-6748.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it, Blasting Station and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

821-2173-2403-5220.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

560-1115-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1753-3259-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
1753-3259-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1789-4050-5649-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-4050-5649-5929.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1432-1719--80.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
1432-1719--80.description:
If Vizier of Tumbling Sands is not your Ring-bearer, use the card that causes the Ring to tempt you to cause Vizier of Tumbling Sands to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and another legendary creature.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat from step 2.

710-3967-4775.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

914-4823-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-4823-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Timeless Witness.
When Dockside Extortionist and Timeless Witness enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
914-4823-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1283-2500-2645-5112.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2500-2645-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Mairsil using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Mairsil.
Activate Mairsil using Mirage Mirror's ability by paying {2}, causing Mairsil to become a copy of itself until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may also activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability and/or any of Staff of Domination's other abilities each loop.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2034-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-2034-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dargo, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

813-1777-3125.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
813-1777-3125.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding {B}{B} and then five mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice a creature and return Scholar of the Ages and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Victimize to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

716-1304-4474-4618.notablePrerequisites:
Nature's Chosen and Paradise Mantle attached to Triton Cavalry.
Triton Cavalry does not have summoning sickness.
716-1304-4474-4618.description:
Activate Triton Cavalry by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nature's Chosen's first ability by paying {0}, untapping Triton Cavalry.
Cast Instill Energy by paying {G}, targeting Triton Cavalry.
Triton Cavalry triggers, returning Nature's Chosen to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Instill Energy, attaching it to Triton Cavalry.
Activate Triton Cavalry by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping Triton Cavalry.
Cast Nature's Chosen by paying {G}, targeting Triton Cavalry.
Triton Cavalry triggers, returning Instill Energy to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Nature's Chosen, attaching it to Triton Cavalry.

168-736-4768-4948.description:
Cast Estrid's Invocation by paying {2}{U}.
Estrid's Invocation enters the battlefield, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Estrid's Invocation's trigger, becoming a copy of Oblivion Ring and exiling Oblivion Ring.
Cast Copy Enchantment by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Copy Enchantment enters the battlefield, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Copy Enchantment's trigger, becoming a copy of Estrid's Invocation and exiling Estrid's Invocation.
Estrid's Invocation leaves the battlefield, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Altar of the Brood and Oblivion Ring triggers.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring's trigger, exiling Copy Enchantment.
Copy Enchantment leaves the battlefield, returning Estrid's Invocation from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
